accessibility_requirements: keyboard-operable sort buttons and anchor selector with visible focus
semantic table (caption, scope col/row, aria sort labels)
source distinction by shape + text, never color-only
gap direction by sign + text label, never color-only
status by text chip, never color-only
native details disclosure for provenance (no hover-only explanations)

api_dependency.compare: POST /v2/consensus/compare (single request per selection, abort-guarded, no polling)

availability_states: NOT_COMPARABLE: available arm shown, missing arm as explicit unavailable text, disagreement hidden
error: typed message + retry, no stale fabrication
loading: role=status text, no skeleton overload
demo_fixture_disclosure: HISTORICAL REPLAY chip + illustrative-state note on every render; 2022-r03-R lap 2 selected truth-blind (leader mismatch x largest max|gap|); magnitude not presented as typical
frontend_data_rule: backend-authoritative values rendered verbatim (native*100 for display); ranks/ties/intervals never recomputed; no research records, model artifacts, or simulator internals imported
gap_sign_convention: signed gap = simulation - model (+ simulation higher, - model higher), visible beside the table and in column help
leader_semantics: backend tie-safe leader sets rendered in full, never cut to one; LEADER SPLIT / LEADER MATCH are neutral descriptions, not verdicts
mc_sampling_wording: MC SAMPLING RANGE + valid-trials count; labelled finite-simulation sampling; never confidence/certainty/real-world uncertainty; never visually dominant

probability_family_labels.model: Independent binary WIN probabilities — one per driver, never summing to a field total
probability_family_labels.simulation: Winner frequencies over mutually exclusive simulated outcomes

responsive_requirements: 390px mobile: 4 priority columns (driver/model/sim/gap), rank detail collapsed, no viewport overflow, usable touch targets
top_k_wording: top-k WIN-ranking overlap (+ Jaccard); explicitly NOT P(finish<=k) wherever shown
unsupported_behavior: typed refusal reason in product language; unavailable never rendered as 0%; disagreement requires both sources
visualization: paired dumbbell rows (square=MODEL, disc=SIM) on a shared native scale with text values; no midpoint, no averaging, no fill, no band
year_2025_behavior: explicit unsupported state with factual reason; no fallback year; no research-only predictions; page still renders
